name: How can I improve my home's energy efficiency with new doors?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve my home's energy efficiency with new doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: To improve your home's energy efficiency with new doors, look for models with features designed to reduce heat transfer and air leakage. Options with a high R-value or U-factor indicate better insulation properties. Double-pane or triple-pane glass with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings in patio or entry doors significantly reduces heat gain and loss. Also, ensure the door has robust weatherstripping and a good seal around the perimeter to prevent drafts. Proper installation by a professional is crucial, as even the most energy-efficient door will perform poorly if not sealed correctly into the opening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve energy efficiency by choosing doors with high R-values, low U-factors, and Low-E glass, especially for patio or entry doors. Ensure robust weatherstripping and professional installation for optimal sealing against drafts.
